purpose: Canonical B01 actionable-intention descriptor for one Activity in the authenticated self-Person context; it extends the existing Activity NativeRef without creating a second Activity identity.

columns.name: activity_ref
columns.meaning: Stable Activity NativeRef whose minimum actionable-intention descriptor this row carries.
columns.value_contract: References one existing UUIDv7 Activity identity; the descriptor does not mint or replace that identity.

columns.name: self_person_ref
columns.meaning: Authenticated DANTE self Person whose personal Activity context owns this B01 descriptor.
columns.value_contract: Existing Person NativeRef resolved through DanteContext; Person remains distinct from Account/Principal/Actor.

columns.name: title
columns.meaning: Minimum user-authored actionable-intention title for the Activity.
columns.value_contract: Trimmed, non-empty, at most 300 characters; this is not a generic Task/status payload.

columns.name: created_at
columns.meaning: Canonical creation instant recorded by the bounded CreateActivity capability.
columns.value_contract: Statement-time instant supplied inside the authoritative PostgreSQL create capability.

primary_key.name: pk_activity_intention
primary_key.reason: Exactly one current B01 actionable-intention descriptor is materialized per Activity identity.

foreign_keys.name: fk_activity_intention_activity_ref_activity
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: The descriptor belongs to the existing Activity native owner rather than introducing a second Activity root.

foreign_keys.name: fk_activity_intention_self_person_ref_person
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: B01 is intentionally self-scoped while preserving Person as a separate native owner and leaving future actor relations to their own roadmap block.

check_constraints.name: ck_activity_intention_title
check_constraints.reason: Reject empty, padded or unbounded minimum Activity titles at the database boundary.

indexes.name: ix_activity_intention_self_person_created
indexes.reason: Deterministic self-scoped unplaced/activity-list ordering without using presentation state as canonical truth.

state_history.current_binding: The B01 minimum descriptor is selected directly by Activity NativeRef; it is not a Schedule/Actual/Session MaterialState facet.
state_history.chronology: created_at records the authoritative creation instant; UUIDv7 ordering is never substituted for chronology.
state_history.immutability_policy: B01 exposes create/read only. Future Activity editing must introduce an explicitly governed semantic/history design rather than generic runtime UPDATE authority.

lifecycle.retention: Retained with the canonical Activity while that Activity remains part of accepted DANTE product truth.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No runtime DELETE in B01. The introducing migration refuses downgrade once canonical Activity intention rows exist; destructive evolution requires a separately reviewed forward migration.

obligations: Activity identity remains the existing UUIDv7 NativeRef and is not duplicated by the descriptor
runtime can read but cannot directly INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE the descriptor
title integrity and self-Person foreign-key scope are enforced in real PostgreSQL
canonical Activity data blocks destructive B01 downgrade
